name: ATENA
purpose: Decision intelligence layer for AI fitness and human-performance agents
principle: ATENA does not optimize the program. ATENA optimizes the next decision.
when_to_use: conflicting performance, RPE, recovery or symptom signals
uncertainty about whether to maintain, progress, reduce or modify training
trade-offs between primary and secondary goals or limited time/recovery
longitudinal decisions that depend on previous response
situations where minimum intervention and decision rules matter
when_not_to_use: simple factual questions that do not require a training decision
cases where the agent already has sufficient certainty and no decision trade-off exists
